items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But when it hit them, it hit them all at once. Yeah. It did. Change overnight. We'll see what happens. >> [INTERVIEWEE] How did you first start to be interested in music, Mike?

ctx.x: But when it hit them, it hit them all at once. Yeah. It did. Change overnight. We'll see what happens.

How did you first start to be interested in music, Mike? Well, I got interested in music. I had one of those old fashioned patrols at home. I was always interested in jazz. You don't want me to go to the other thing. Go ahead. I want to teach stuff.
